Technical THT and SMT
back to the list
Founded in 2012, the OK JOB SA group has twenty agencies (in Switzerland, Germany and now also in Ticino) and specialized services. We have more than 30 years of experience in fixed and temporary placement.
Description du job
We are looking for a
Technical THT and SMT
What we ask
- Experience in the maintenance of industrial machinery and equipment
- Knowledge of THT production processes and, preferably, SMT
- Experience on automated welding systems Selective and Wave, preferably ERSA / SEHO
- Good knowledge of mechanics, electrical engineering, electronics and pneumatics
- Ability of fault and diagnostic research
- Knowledge of electronic components and welding processes
- Ability to intervene on faults and machine stops
- Experience or predisposition to preventive and corrective maintenance
- Availability to collaborate with production and Process Engineering
- Ability to propose improved and corrective solutions
Profil
Your profile
- Autonomous and responsible for your work
- With strong problem solving skills
- Precise and reliable
- Capable of working both independently and in team
- Flexible and able to manage priorities
- Be careful in identifying anomalies and criticalities
- Guided to problem solving and continuous improvement
Your prospects
- A serene climate of work in a company with experience in the field
- Possibility of personal growth
- Remuneration for experience and skills
If you are interested send your full application to: savior.lazzaro@okjob.ch
Or come visit us at our headquarters in Via Stefano Franscini, 10, 6850 Mendrisio

Technical/industrial specialist L1 - Automation/polymechanical

- Preventive maintenance: periodic checks according to maintenance plans.
- Career maintenance: diagnosis and repair of vehicle failures.

back to list
In order to strengthen our teams, we are looking for a production and assembly manager in metal construction (M/F).

Your mission:
- Plan and supervise the entire production process, from workshop to on-site installation
- Organize and coordinate production and assembly teams, ensuring timeliness and budget
- Technical monitoring of projects (reading plans, quality control, compliance with metal construction standards)
- Manage material supply and optimal use of resources (machines, personnel, subcontractors)
- Ensure strict application of safety standards at production and assembly sites
- Ensure the interface between the design office, clients and operational teams
- Monitoring the conformity of the works delivered and managing any non-compliance
- Optimize production processes to improve productivity and quality

- Technical training in metal, mechanical or civil engineering (CFC with patent/master's degree, HES engineer or equivalent)
- Experience confirmed for several years in a position of production manager or construction manager in metal construction
- Strong team management and leadership skills
- Good knowledge of the reading of technical drawings and metal construction standards (SIA, welding standards, etc.)
- Meaning of organization, planning and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Rigor, analytical spirit and ability to solve technical problems in the field
- Good communication skills for the interface between teams, clients and study desk
- Driver's licence category B required
- Current French; knowledge in German or English is an asset according to the projects
